6196.title: Same-repository PR issue exemption verified on main
6196.rootCauseOneLine: The former issue guard exempted OWNER/MEMBER but not same-repository collaborators; main now skips the issue check for same-repository heads.

prReviews.topFinding: Nine workflow behavior cases passed twice; removing the added branch-origin guard reproduces closure.

6196.proposedFix: Already landed in 5f3ceb1649921f1bd2e167aee611561bcb751248 via #6197; no duplicate PR.
